column2: And judging by the way you acted earlier, you yourself...
look like you want to believe in the $$邪教の教え$$ called $$愛$$, deep down!
W-what?!
Hey, hey! You seriously mean to make someone like her a companion?!
Recruit her
Don't recruit her
Whoa, you're serious?!
With someone like her around, no telling when she'll stab us in the back... Wait...
Come to think of it, she's no different from that fop over there!
Fine, then. Just make sure you never walk in front of me!!
And don't walk behind me either!
What did you call me?!
$$プラハ$$ joined the party!
Oh! Come to think of it,
I heard there's a little girl with black $$羽$$ locked in the $$独房$$ at the back...
What?!
They say the girl locked in there sneaked into the butcher's every night and stole loads of animals...
then took them home...
But for a little theft like that, they'd normally just catch her, kill her on the spot, and be done with it, right?!
But when they caught her, she supposedly shouted back at the butcher...
Killing animals is cruel!! Something absolutely outrageous like that...
What the hell is that?!
C-cruel? But if you don't kill them, you can't eat meat, can you?!
S-she must be seriously... wrong in the head, right?!
What should we do?! Should we unlock this $$独房$$ too...?
Yes
No
W-what the hell are you doing all of a sudden, you... □☆♂♀!!
But, little miss...
Humans aren't the only ones—animals can't live without taking the lives of other animals...
They're $$罪$$ful creatures...
More importantly, what are we doing with her?
Take her with us
Leave her here
Well, sure, we can't leave a kid alone in a place like this... Wait, what?!
What are you getting all flirty for, you meat thief?!
We can't keep dragging a kid around forever... Agh!!
$$プリカ$$ joined the party!
That's right!
We don't have time to fuss over dead weight like that!
Let's find something that can be used as a weapon and get the hell out of here!
It's not that.
The cowardly me... stood up to them like that!
I'm just... so happy! It's like...
Hey... who's a coward?
Interesting! We're escaped criminals on the run, anyway!!
Even if we flee alone, it'll only make fighting our pursuers harder.
Looks like we'll have to join forces for a while.
At any rate, old man, let me say one thing...
Putting everything else aside,
don't go stealing other people's $$セリフ$$s!!
